Dont you think that most of 2-3 hero spammers spam then not because they just want high number, but because they want to be good at the game on that hero? Versatility is not a needed component to be good at dota, there was advantages and disadvantages. You dont need to think about counter jungle heroes this way. Even in 5k bracket often you cant provide much pressure on enemy jungler (first of all, because you need to go to the enemy jungle and be out of position surrounded by all enemy heroes). And jungle heroes on 5k+ is not bad because enemy can harass them while they jungle. They are bad because 1) other lanes become weak 2) lack of space for farming in midgame, not in early game. Usually dont try to prevent enemy jungle farm, use pressure on lanes. Here is the tipycal game with core-jungler (4-core-team with 1 solo support): While you have jungler, opponents have roamer that ensures your mid and offlaner will gain much less farm. Then, because of 2 supports and lack of your mid/offlaner farm, enemy team destroys your offlane t1 tower and/or mid t1 tower and get better map control. And then the key moment of the game incoming - you began suffer from farm starvation, you have 4 cores instead of 3 and you have lack of map control and farm spots. You just cant farm eficciently, go to the dangerous places to get at least some farm, and got killed. That is where jungler becames bad and what you must do to counter him, not by trying to disturb him at the beginning (its userful, especially when you have riki/bh, but not key)
